title: Event
description: A historical event. Primary sort: sorting_year, derived from the cfah chronology entry when available (see sorting_basis).

sorting_year.description: CFAH-weighted sort key; negative = BC. Uses the cfah year when present; otherwise the fallback named in sorting_basis.

standby.description: Optional placement when sorting_year is null. Allowed for future use. Events that already have a sort year must not carry it.

sort_order_within_year.description: Tie-breaker for events in the same year (lower first).
